content:
Entra en AI Video y selecciona Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0 para usar el flujo integrado de generación de video.  
Sube imágenes, videos, audio o texto como referencias (hasta 12 archivos a la vez) para guiar la generación y mantener coherencia visual.  
Usa “@” en el prompt para asignar el rol de cada material de referencia antes de generar.  
Activa/usa el control de first-to-last frame para definir directamente el inicio y el final del video y dejar que el modelo genere las transiciones intermedias automáticamente.  
Define la dirección del video mediante materiales de referencia y restricciones (consistencia de personajes, movimiento de cámara, continuidad de acciones) en lugar de ajustar frame por frame.

en.content:
Enter AI Video and select Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0 to use the integrated video generation workflow.  
Upload images, videos, audio, or text as references (up to 12 files at a time) to guide the generation and maintain visual coherence.  
Use “@” in the prompt to assign the role of each reference material before generating.  
Activate/use the first-to-last frame control to directly define the start and end of the video and let the model automatically generate the intermediate transitions.  
Define the direction of the video through reference materials and constraints (character consistency, camera movement, action continuity) instead of adjusting frame by frame.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] With its multimodal approach, Dreamina Seedance 2.0 can simultaneously process images, videos, audio, and text, enhancing consistency and significantly increasing the level of control and expressiveness in the results.  
In Dreamina you can do it like this:  
1. Enter AI Video and select Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0  
2. Upload images, videos, audio, or text as references (up to 12 files at a time)  
3. Use “@” in the prompt to assign the role of each material  
4. Write your prompt  
5. Click generate and get the result  
The model combines everything while maintaining visual coherence.

[Thread 2] You no longer need to manually control each frame; instead, you can define the direction through reference materials and constraints, and leave the rest to the model. Whether it's character consistency, camera movement, or action continuity, everything maintains good coherence and natural physical logic.  
Especially with the first-to-last frame control, you can directly define the start and end of the video, and the model automatically generates the intermediate transitions. This allows for a natural transition from one scene to another, or for a character to complete a specific movement trajectory more easily and controllably.  
This reduces the need for frame-by-frame adjustments while achieving dynamic results closer to what is expected.

[Thread 3] If you want to try it yourself, you can do so here:  
https://t.co/5YPU6xU70D  
#dreamina #seedance #dreaminaseedance2 #ai #aitools #dreaminapartner
